payload.rebuttal: argued: This blocker points at saffron/record/migrate.py:234, outside touches (only tests/test_record_migrate.py) and inside forbidden (saffron/**). The spec requires migrate.py to stay untouched and requires modified_held to be built exactly as the inline block built it: a copy of held with only the first gate_result's first failure message changed. I verified, by running the pre-refactor inline test against this exact wrong version in a throwaway clone, that it survives identically against the old and the new test: for this task's fixture, held's compared-kind facts (attempt_opened, attempt_closed, gate_result) match truth's counts for every kind before gate_result, so the wrong version's by-kind loop finds the gate_result disagreement and breaks before ever reaching an append. No change inside the block I'm allowed to edit can alter that, since the fact shapes come entirely from setup code before line 2629, which I may not touch.
